metadata.description: Free, open AI-agent skills from Majarrah Nexus.

plugins.name: skill-craft
plugins.description: Technical review, guided walkthroughs, and a human-attention approval gate for agent skills, slash commands, and plugins — a fixed 10-dimension safety/severity audit, a clear five-part walkthrough, and a decision layer that says how much a human must read before approving. Custom-agent review and authoring are not included.

plugins.name: code-craft
plugins.description: Two architecture skills. clean-architecture — Clean Architecture feature implementation for any stack, mobile (Flutter, Android, iOS, React Native), web frontend, backend service, or desktop, with bundled mappings for the four mobile stacks and Node backends and every other stack derived live from the project's own conventions. compose-screen-architecture — the screen layer for Android Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform, Route/Screen split, state ownership, ViewModel scope and lifetimes, outcomes and restoration, platform UI adapters, KMP versus Android-only placement; everything below the ViewModel hands off to clean-architecture. Project conventions are detected first and always win over either skill's defaults.
